## Summary

What changed, and which example or documentation area does it affect?

## Validation

- [ ] Focused tests were run for changed examples.
- [ ] Live/manual run was performed when the example requires it, or the reason
      it was skipped is documented.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when user-facing behavior changed.

## Compatibility

- [ ] The change uses supported public RPA Core APIs only.
- [ ] Per-example dependency pins still target the compatible RPA Core release.
- [ ] Any required matching framework change is linked or explained.

## Data Safety

- [ ] No credentials, private URLs, local checkout paths, generated databases,
      logs, screenshots, or sensitive output files were added.
